lines.en: label rindorm15:
I knock on Rin's door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Rin 的门，等她来应门。

lines.en: The faint sound of her humming some song I've never heard before is quickly replaced by a series of demands that I have no intention of fulfilling.
lines.zh: 她哼着一首我从没听过的歌的微弱声音，很快被一连串我根本没打算照做的要求取代了。

lines.en: : Get out of here, loser! How many times do I have to tell you to stop coming around without some sort of offering?
lines.zh: : 滚出去，废物！我到底要说多少次，别不带点贡品就往这儿跑？

lines.en: : Is that...a thing you told me?
lines.zh: : 那是……你跟我说过的话吗？

lines.en: : Besides, I shouldn't have to pay an admission to see one of my students.
lines.zh: : 再说了，看我的学生之一，我总不该还要付门票钱吧。

lines.en: : In fact, you should probably be the one paying me for house calls now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 事实上，现在想想，该付我出诊费的人大概是你。

lines.en: : I didn't even call you, though? You can't just drop by unannounced and charge me for it. That's an abuse of power.
lines.zh: : 可我根本没叫你来啊？你不能不打招呼就上门，然后还跟我要钱。那是滥用职权。

lines.en: : I'll waive the fee if you let me in. I'm bored and need something to do.
lines.zh: : 你让我进去就免收费用。我太无聊了，得找点事做。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. Nobody's charging anybody. I was just messing with you.
lines.zh: : 好啦好啦。谁也不收谁的钱。我刚才就是逗你玩的。

lines.en: : Come back later, though. Kind of in the middle of something here.
lines.zh: : 不过你待会儿再来吧。我这儿正忙着呢。

lines.en: : And what are you in the middle of, exactly?
lines.zh: : 你具体在忙什么？

lines.en: : Waiting for the rest of this body I found to melt. They really don't make sulfuric acid like they used to, do they?
lines.zh: : 等我找到的这具尸体剩下的部分融化完。现在的硫酸真是不如从前好使了，对吧？

lines.en: : Can I at least know whose body it is?
lines.zh: : 我至少能知道那是谁的尸体吗？

lines.en: : Mmm...not sure. And I think it might be past the point of identification since I started with the head.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不确定。而且我觉得可能已经过了能辨认的阶段了，毕竟我是从头部开始溶的。

lines.en: scene black
: Doesn't mean I can't try. If you've killed one of your classmates, I'd like to at least confirm which one it is.
lines.zh: : 那也不代表我不能试试。要是你杀了自己的某个同学，我至少想确认一下是哪个。

lines.en: : Wait? What? No! I wasn't kidding! Stay out!
lines.zh: : 等等？什么？不！我是在开玩笑！别进来！

lines.en: : Why? There's no way you have an actual-
lines.zh: : 为什么？你总不可能真的有——

lines.en: scene boundariesredux1
: Oh.
: So that's what you were in the middle of.
lines.zh: : 原来你忙的是这个。

lines.en: : You...
scene boundariesredux2
: Sensei, what the actual fuck?! You can't just walk into someone's room whenever you want!
lines.zh: : Sensei，你他妈到底在搞什么？！你不能想什么时候进别人房间就什么时候进！

lines.en: : In my defense, you provided probable cause for investigation. I was just trying to be a good person.
lines.zh: : 为自己辩护一句，是你给了我合理怀疑的理由。我只是想当个好人。

lines.en: : Probable cause?! To barge into a girl's room while she's changing?!
lines.zh: : 合理怀疑？！就为了在女生换衣服的时候闯进她房间？！

lines.en: : To stop the...dissolving of a body?
lines.zh: : 为了阻止……一具尸体的溶解？

lines.en: : There is obviously no body!
lines.zh: : 明明根本就没有什么尸体！

lines.en: : There is very much a body. Just not one I expected to see this much of so early on.
lines.zh: : 尸体可是确确实实有的。只是我没料到这么早就看到这么多。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux3
: Yeah, you're telling me...
lines.zh: : 是啊，说得就是呢……

lines.en: : So...what's new?
lines.zh: : 那么……最近怎么样？

lines.en: : Are you fucking kidding?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在开玩笑吧？

lines.en: : What-
lines.zh: : 什么——

lines.en: scene boundariesredux4
: Get the fuck out of here, dude! I'm feeling totally fucking violated right now!
lines.zh: : 给我他妈滚出去，老兄！我现在感觉被彻底侵犯了！

lines.en: scene black
: See, that was all you needed to say. I'm gone.
lines.zh: : 看吧，你说这句就够了。我走了。

lines.en: : Cool! Bye!
lines.zh: : 酷！拜！

lines.en: : In the future, it might be smart to tell someone you're getting changed instead of dissolving a body if you don't want them to come in.
lines.zh: : 以后要是不想让人进来，与其说自己在溶解尸体，说你在换衣服可能更明智一点。

lines.en: : Oh, yes! My bad, Sensei! How stupid I was to think there was a right way and wrong way to tell someone to stay out of your room!
lines.zh: : 哦，对！我的错，Sensei！我真蠢，居然以为「让别人别进你房间」还有什么正确说法和错误说法之分！

lines.en: : I'm glad you have seen the error of your ways.
lines.zh: : 我很高兴你认识到了自己的错误。

lines.en: : Fuck you, jerk!
lines.zh: : 去你的，混蛋！

lines.en: : What did you just throw at the door?
lines.zh: : 你刚才往门上扔了什么？

lines.en: : A fucking book. And now I have to go {i}back{/i} to the door and pick it up because it landed halfway open and I don't want the cover bending.
lines.zh: : 一本他妈的书。现在我得走{i}回{/i}门口把它捡起来，因为它落在了半开的地方，我可不想封面被压弯。

lines.en: : So, you're still naked and right on the other side of this door right now?
lines.zh: : 所以你现在还光着，就在这扇门的另一边？

lines.en: : I wasn't {i}naked!{/i} I just didn't have a bra on!
lines.zh: : 我才没{i}光着{/i}！我只是没穿胸罩！

lines.en: : Oh, so it's fine if I come back in?
lines.zh: : 哦，那我再进去也没关系咯？

lines.en: : Touch that fucking door knob again and I swear to god I will actually find a way to procure sulfuric acid.
lines.zh: : 你再敢碰那个该死的门把手，我发誓我真的会想办法弄到硫酸。

lines.en: I find myself back out in the hall, speaking through the door to a factually {i}not{/i} naked Rin.
lines.zh: 我又回到了走廊上，隔着门跟一个事实上并{i}没有{/i}光着身子的 Rin 说话。

lines.en: Needless to say, she is mad. Which she has every right to be.
lines.zh: 不用说，她在生气。而她完全有权利生气。

lines.en: I made the conscious decision to invade her privacy for the sake of a joke and am now paying the price for it.
lines.zh: 为了一个玩笑，我做出了侵犯她隐私的清醒决定，现在正在为此付出代价。

lines.en: But do I regret that even a little? Absolutely not.
lines.zh: 可我有哪怕一丝后悔吗？一点也没有。

lines.en: In fact, I'd do it all over again if I didn't think she would actually find some way to dissolve my body in sulfuric acid.
lines.zh: 事实上，如果不是怕她真能弄到硫酸把我的尸体溶了，我还会再来一遍。

lines.en: : Are you still there?
lines.zh: : 你还在吗？

lines.en: : Are you still not naked?
lines.zh: : 你还光着吗？

lines.en: : You fucking...yes. I am decidedly un-naked now. And I will let you back into the room under one condition.
lines.zh: : 你他妈的……在。我现在确定已经不——光——了。而且我可以让你回房间，但有一个条件。

lines.en: : Yeah, I guess it would only be fair if you got to see me without my clothes on as well.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那如果你也能看一次我光着的样子，大概才算公平吧。

lines.en: : That's obviously not what I'm talking about!
lines.zh: : 我说的显然不是这个！

lines.en: : Just fucking come in. But know that I am very, very, very, very, VERY mad at you.
lines.zh: : 他妈的进来吧。但你要知道，我现在非常、非常、非常、非常、非常生你的气。

lines.en: Once again, I open the door. Just this time, I have permission.
lines.zh: 我再一次打开了门。只不过这一次，我是有许可的。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux5
: Oh no. Your condition is an apology, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 哦不。你的条件是要我道歉，对吧？

lines.en: : Do I not deserve one?
lines.zh: : 我难道不该得到一个道歉吗？

lines.en: : You do. I'm just not very good at them.
lines.zh: : 你该。我只是不太擅长道歉。

lines.en: : Will you accept a series of compliments instead?
lines.zh: : 那用一连串赞美来代替行吗？

lines.en: : Compliments under these circumstances would likely only make me angrier.
lines.zh: : 在这种情境下的赞美，大概只会让我更生气。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux6
: That was really fucked up, dude. Like, I'm not even kidding.
lines.zh: : 那真的太过分了，老兄。我是说，我一点都没在开玩笑。

lines.en: : Don't do that again.
lines.zh: : 别再有下次了。

lines.en: : You know I didn't actually mean any harm, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我其实并没有恶意，对吧？

lines.en: : You don't have to {i}mean{/i} harm to actually harm someone, you know. Like, what if it was someone other than me that you walked in on?
lines.zh: : 你不必{i}心怀{/i}恶意，也一样能真的伤到人，你知道吗。比如，如果你撞见的是别人而不是我呢？

lines.en: : What if it was someone who wanted to get you in trouble? Because they'd definitely be able to after that little stunt.
lines.zh: : 如果是某个想让你惹上麻烦的人呢？就凭你刚才那手，她们绝对能办到。

lines.en: : I'm sorry. It won't happen again.
lines.zh: : 对不起。不会有下次了。

lines.en: : You mean it?
lines.zh: : 你说真的？

lines.en: : As much as I possibly can.
lines.zh: : 尽我所能地认真。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux5
: Hmph...
scene boundariesredux6
: Do you know what this means, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你知道这意味着什么吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : What...{i}what{/i} means?
lines.zh: : 什么……意味着{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : As of today...
lines.zh: : 从今天起……

lines.en: : Everyone in our class has officially seen my boobs.
lines.zh: : 我们班上的每一个人都正式看过我的胸了。

lines.en: : I want to say I'm glad to be a part of the club, but I don't know if now is really the right time.
lines.zh: : 我倒是想说很高兴成为这个俱乐部的一员，但我不知道现在是不是合适的时机。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux7
: Hah...It is what it is. There's no way to go back in time and change it from happening. I'll just have to...always lock the door now or something.
lines.zh: : 哈……事情就是这样。又没办法穿越回去让它不发生。我以后大概只能……记得随时锁门之类的了。

lines.en: : To be fair, that's something you should have already been doing.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，那本来就是你该做的事。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux8
: Why? We all see each other without our clothes on all the time. It barely makes a difference anymore.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我们大家向来都互相看过不穿衣服的样子。现在早就没什么差别了。

lines.en: : I mean...doesn't it make a difference for {i}you?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是说……对{i}你{/i}来说难道没差别吗？

lines.en: : Are you implying that, since I'm bisexual, I'm unable to strip in front of my classmates without getting turned on?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示，因为我是双性恋，我就没法在同学面前脱衣服而不被挑起性致？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: : 差不多，是的。

lines.en: : That is an extremely rude thing to say.
lines.zh: : 这话可真够失礼的。

lines.en: : It is also 100%% accurate.
lines.zh: : 而且它 100%% 准确。

lines.en: : But it's {i}not{/i} because I am bisexual, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 但那{i}不{/i}是因为我是双性恋，Sensei……

lines.en: : It's because I am a fucking pervert.
lines.zh: : 是因为我他妈就是个变态。

lines.en: : I feel like I'm getting to see a whole new side of you today, and that's not just because I got to see you topless a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 我感觉今天看到了你全新的一面，而这还不只是因为我几分钟前看到了你上身裸体的样子。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux9
: Whatever. You're welcome for the new fantasies, loser.
lines.zh: : 随便啦。新幻想不用谢，废物。

lines.en: : So, what brings you here today? Apart from the whole peeping tom thing.
lines.zh: : 那么，今天什么风把你吹来了？除了偷窥狂那件事之外。

lines.en: : Just trying to kill some time, I guess. And time normally seems to move a bit faster with you around.
lines.zh: : 大概就是想打发时间吧。而只要有你在，时间通常似乎过得快一点。

lines.en: : Well, thanks for-
lines.zh: : 嗯，谢谢——

lines.en: scene boundariesredux10
: Wait, that {i}was{/i} a compliment, right? I can’t really tell.
lines.zh: : 等等，那{i}算是{/i}赞美吧？我真的分不出来。

lines.en: : I think so? Just like with apologies, I'm not really great at those either.
lines.zh: : 应该算吧？就像道歉一样，赞美我也不太擅长。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux9
: Well, thanks. You’re pretty fun to be around too. When you're not invading my privacy, I mean.
lines.zh: : 嗯，谢了。跟你在一起也挺开心的。我是说，在你不侵犯我隐私的时候。

lines.en: : So, where’s Futaba tonight?
lines.zh: : 那么，Futaba 今晚在哪儿？

lines.en: : It’s pretty late. I figured she’d be home by now.
lines.zh: : 已经挺晚了。我还以为她这会儿该回来了。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux11
: {i}Gasp!{/i} Does this mean that you have finally fallen for my beloved roommate and borderline-sister, Futaba Fukuyama?
lines.zh: : {i}倒吸一口气！{/i}莫非你终于迷上了我亲爱的室友、介于姐妹之间的 Futaba Fukuyama？

lines.en: : Did you just say {i}gasp{/i} out loud instead of actually gasping?
lines.zh: : 你刚刚是把「{i}倒吸一口气{/i}」这句话说出来了，而不是真的倒吸一口气？

lines.en: : Also, all I did was ask where she is. That doesn't mean I'm in love with her.
lines.zh: : 还有，我只是问她在哪儿而已。那不代表我爱上她了。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux12
: Futaba is sleeping at a friend’s place tonight.
lines.zh: : Futaba 今晚睡在一个朋友家。

lines.en: if day < 5:
: Really? Even though we have school tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 真的？哪怕我们明天还要上学？

lines.en: else:
: Really? That’s new.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那倒是新鲜。

lines.en: : Yup. One of our friends from middle[school].
lines.zh: : 嗯。是我们初中[学校]的一个朋友。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux13
: Well, mostly her friend I guess. The two of us never really hit it off the way they did.
lines.zh: : 好吧，大概主要是她的朋友。我们两个从来没像她们那样合得来。

lines.en: : Though...there are certainly {i}some{/i} things we do see eye to eye on.
lines.zh: : 不过……确实有{i}某些{/i}事我们的看法是一致的。

lines.en: : Girl friend or guy friend?
lines.zh: : 女性朋友还是男性朋友？

lines.en: scene boundariesredux14
: Would you be jealous if I said it was a guy?
lines.zh: : 如果我说是个男的，你会吃醋吗？

lines.en: : Maybe a little bit. I’d like to at least meet him first if he’s going to be corrupting one of my students.
lines.zh: : 也许有一点。如果他要带坏我的学生之一，我至少想先见见他。

lines.en: : Well, I guess you lucked out then. Because Nodoka is {i}definitely{/i} a girl.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那你运气不错。因为 Nodoka {i}绝对{/i}是个女生。

lines.en: : I'm feeling a little put off by the emphasis on that {i}definitely.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你特意强调「{i}绝对{/i}」，让我有点在意。

lines.en: : Let that be your hint on what exactly she and I see eye to eye on, then.
lines.zh: : 那就把它当成我和她究竟在哪些事上看法一致的提示吧。

lines.en: : Ahh. Another lesbian.
lines.zh: : 啊。又一个女同。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux15
: Our forces grow stronger by the day.
lines.zh: : 我们的队伍日益壮大。

lines.en: : Also, bisexual.
lines.zh: : 还有，是双性恋。

lines.en: : Whatever the case, knowing Futaba's not off in the arms of some random guy will help me sleep a little better. So thanks for clarifying, Rin.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，知道 Futaba 没有躺在某个陌生男人怀里，能让我今晚睡得好一点。所以谢谢你说明白，Rin。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux16
if cafe10 == True:
: Speaking of which, didn't you say something about sleeping troubles at the cafe a few days ago?
lines.zh: : 说到这个，你前几天在咖啡厅是不是说过睡眠有点问题？

lines.en: : Yeah, but that doesn't really have anything to do with Futaba. Or...anyone for that matter?
lines.zh: : 嗯，可那跟 Futaba 真没什么关系。或者说……跟任何人都没关系？

lines.en: else:
: Have you been having trouble sleeping lately or something?
lines.zh: : 你最近是不是睡不好之类的？

lines.en: : Not really. It's just a phrase.
lines.zh: : 也不算。那只是个说法而已。

lines.en: : You sure? Need me to come over and read you bedtime stories or something?
lines.zh: : 你确定？需要我过来给你读睡前故事什么的吗？

lines.en: : As long as you read some to Ami as well. I'm sure she'd like that.
lines.zh: : 只要你也给 Ami 读就行。我敢肯定她会喜欢的。

lines.en: : Ami can be pretty weird at times, but I don't really think she'd go for me randomly showing up one night and reading to her.
lines.zh: : Ami 有时候是挺怪的，但我不太觉得她会喜欢我某天晚上突然出现给她念故事。

lines.en: : It's worth a shot, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得值得一试。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux17
: I'll add it to my rapidly growing list of things to do...Which actually allows me to segue into this!
lines.zh: : 我会把它加进我那飞速增长的待办清单里……而这正好让我能顺接到这件事！

lines.en: scene boundariesredux12
: Go home.
lines.zh: : 回家吧。

lines.en: : What? But I didn't even do anything wrong this time.
lines.zh: : 什么？可我这次明明什么都没做错。

lines.en: : This time, no. But I already had plans with somebody else tonight and you are currently getting in the way of them.
lines.zh: : 这次，是没做错。但我今晚已经和别人有约了，而你现在正在碍事。

lines.en: : Is {i}your{/i} secret companion also a girl? Or are you sneaking away to-
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}那位神秘同伴也是女生吗？还是说你要偷偷溜去——

lines.en: : I'm gonna cut you off right there and remind you that I greatly prefer girls over guys so, if you're going to get jealous, it should probably be over a female.
lines.zh: : 我这就打断你，顺便提醒你：我比起男生更喜欢女生，所以你要吃醋的话，对象大概该是个女的。

lines.en: : Which it is.
lines.zh: : 而她确实是。

lines.en: : Going on a date this late at night?
lines.zh: : 这么晚了去约会？

lines.en: scene boundariesredux18
: A date? Oh god, no. It's nothing like that at all.
lines.zh: : 约会？天啊，不是。完全不是那么回事。

lines.en: : It's just a friend from a different class.
lines.zh: : 只是别的班的一个朋友。

lines.en: : It might be a little too early to say this, but I didn't think there were any girls you {i}weren't{/i} attracted to.
lines.zh: : 说这个也许有点早，但我还以为没有你{i}不{/i}为之心动的女孩子呢。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux17
: It's not that I'm not attracted to her. She's actually really pretty.
lines.zh: : 倒不是我对她没感觉。她其实真的很漂亮。

lines.en: : She's just a little too much like me.
lines.zh: : 她只是跟我太像了。

lines.en: : And...that's a problem?
lines.zh: : 而……那有什么问题？

lines.en: : Would {i}you{/i} want to date yourself, Sensei?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}自己想跟自己交往吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : With the penis or without the penis?
lines.zh: : 带阴茎的版本，还是不带阴茎的版本？

lines.en: : Why not both?
lines.zh: : 为什么不能两个都要？

lines.en: : Okay, I'm going to let you leave now.
lines.zh: : 好了，我现在放你走了。

lines.en: scene boundariesredux12
: We can leave together. She's in a different dorm, so I have to go meet up with her elsewhere anyway.
lines.zh: : 我们可以一起走。她住另一栋宿舍，反正我也得去别的地方跟她碰头。

lines.en: : Wow, look at me. Forgiving you {i}and{/i} letting you walk with me even though you stole a glimpse at my delicate, maiden body earlier. I'm so awesome.
lines.zh: : 哇，看看我多伟大。明明你刚才偷瞄了我娇嫩的少女身躯，我{i}还{/i}原谅你、让你跟我一起走。我真是太好了。

lines.en: : And extremely humble, too.
lines.zh: : 而且还极其谦逊。

lines.en: : After you, Rin.
lines.zh: : 您先请，Rin。

lines.en: : Why thank you, sir. You're such a gentleman when you're not being a pervert.
lines.zh: : 哎呀谢谢您，先生。您不当变态的时候，还真是个绅士。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...it takes one to know one.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……彼此彼此嘛。

lines.en: scene black
Rin and I exit the dorm together, but she breaks away just a few minutes later as it turns out we're heading in opposite directions.
lines.zh: 我和 Rin 一起走出宿舍，但几分钟后她就分开了，因为我们要去的方向正好相反。

lines.en: Without anything left to do, I decide to just go home and call it an early night.
lines.zh: 既然没什么事可做了，我决定干脆回家，早早结束这一晚。

lines.en: I'm surprised that I managed to get off as easy as I did after the stunt I pulled, but I'm not about to try and heat up the water again once it's finally cooled off enough to get into.
lines.zh: 我很意外，闯了那么大的祸居然还能这么轻易脱身，不过既然水终于凉到能下去了，我可不想再把它烧热。

lines.en: As such, I attempt to shelve all of the impure thoughts clouding my mind on the journey home but, as always-
lines.zh: 于是，我试图在回家的路上把脑子里那些龌龊念头全部搁置起来，但一如既往——

lines.en: I fall victim to them in the end.
lines.zh: 最后我还是败给了它们。
